comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
Part of the Dragons of Phantom Seas Memorial Album, this ship decoration can be crafted at Murshid in Candia once you have unlocked the Sea of Wonders -- it gives no stat boosts but looks -very- nice.

Skill required: Handicrafts R15
Ingredients:

Dragon's Blood x50
Platinum Ore x5
Phantom Monster's Relic x10
